profile.headline: Data Science professional with experience in entertainment, retail and hospitality
profile.summary:
•	Hands-on Data Science and Technology leader with experience in attractions, retail, hospitality, entertainment and nonprofit organizations.  
•       Recognized by Computerworld as one of the Top 100 IT leaders.  Recognized by Infoworld as one of the top 25 CTO’s.  Finalist for Georgia CIO of the Year
•	Co-developer of a social media listening platform (TatvamInsights.com) that uses NLP to read entertainment reviews  and user satisfaction surveys to produce actionable insights resulting in a ten percent increase in user satisfaction scores in the first year of implementation.  Used by more than 100 venues in the US. 
•       Developed a mobile application to predict attendance at Georgia Aquarium that was used by 1000 aquarium associates and volunteers.  The attendance projections also provided demand data for a pricing model.
•       Developed a pricing model for Georgia Aquarium that improved revenue by 11% and also contributed to improved guest satisfaction scores.
•       Developed a computer vision based model to predict guest movement at Georgia Aquarium that contributed to improvements in guest flow and guest satisfaction.
•       Developed a pricing model for The Home Depot for UPS deliveries based on product attributes and sales data that supported increased usage of  UPS for deliveries.
•       Developed IP-based credit card authorization for the Home Depot that resulted in a thirty percent reduction in average transaction time and millions in reduced capital expenditures.
•       Developed AI Model for generating rap lyrics resulting in significantly more realistic rap lyrics.
•       Developed Lambda function to calculate beat locations in audio files, reducing compute time tenfold and significantly reducing hosting costs.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Developed progressive web applications for music creators
Developed promotional materials for the business including videos, ad copy and ad campaigns
Conducted market research working with independent artists to assess their needs.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Developed Google Cloud-based applications.
Developed Youtube Integration capability for Music Collaboration Platform.
Developed Application to generate lyrics and melody for songwriters and producers
Developed Mobile-based applications to help performing musicians practice, rehearse and record their music
Developed an AWS Lambda function to calculate beats in audio files reducing calculation times by tenfold and decreasing processing costs dramatically.
Developed containerized deployment for music analysis models using Docker and AWS Lambda.
Developed an Alexa skill for an airport to convey real-time security checkpoint wait times.
Assisted an aquarium client with an attendance forecasting application.
Assisted an aquarium client with a mobile reporting application.
Developed a REST API for internal and external users.
Developed metrics and dashboards to track company performance.
Developed AI-based musical suggestions for artists using OpenAI API.
Developed an AU plugin for generating chord progressions based on musical suggestions.
Deployed ML models to analyze artists' music using Elasticsearch, enhancing search functionality and providing valuable artist feedback through a custom front-end.
Development of music analysis dashboard for artists as part of a music app using ML models derived from Yamnet/VGGISH.
Developed Jupyter notebooks used to collaborate with internal users.
Developed a data warehouse based on AWS RDS and S3.
Developed a transformer model to generate playlists for radio stations using Pytorch.
Utilized 3rd party APIs (Spotify, Apple Music) to collect music metadata.
Developed search algorithm for sync licensing software using Elasticsearch.
Stabilized and modernized legacy software environment.
Deployed ML models to analyze artists’ music to enhance search (Elasticsearch) and provide artist feedback (custom front-end).

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Combine data mining, machine learning skills and musical knowledge to assist with research in music information retrieval algorithms.  
•	Provide assistance with website development.  
•	Developed a machine learning model that predicts chord progressions from audio sources using a CNN/RNN architecture implemented using pytorch.  
•	Develop website using MIR algorithms as proof of concept for repository of symbolic data for musicologists.  http://ec2-3-14-127-103.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com/
•	Implement DSP algorithms in C++ and Python

positions.title: CIO/VP Data Science and Data Aquisition Technology
positions.description:
Vice President Data Science and Data Acquisition Technology - Combine data mining and analytic skills with strong business acumen to provide insights to drive business improvement and success with:
•	Research, design, develop, implement and support decision science models for personalization of message content and next-best-action recommendations at Guest engagement points.
•	Designing and executing validation tests to assess the efficiency of the model (or algorithm) in place and provide strategic insights to stakeholders.
•	Predictive forecasts to maximize customer experience allow for business decision related to staffing, flow, configuration and floor support
•	Exploratory data analytics to identify patterns in Guest behaviors and preferences to uncover hidden possibilities.
•	Monitoring secondary sources for consumer trends, industry trends, brand/product/category developments, and competitor marketing and research activities and integrate findings into research activities.
•	Conceptualizing and building predictive models for such things as price, demand and inventory and to uncover hidden opportunities.
•	Provide strategic direction for development of advanced decisioning and analytics to support business needs.

Vice President Information Technology – Responsible for data science and technology implementation for the best Aquarium in the United States, according to TripAdvisor.  Key accomplishments include:
•	An ecommerce application that improved cash flow, increased revenue and was recognized as “Best in Class” by Computerworld.
•	An “Advertising Dashboard” that contributed to increased revenue and attendance by 10% in a year the aquarium had one of its galleries closed for renovation 
•	Crowd management applications that use predictive analytics to improve guest satisfaction scores.
•	Technology that received the 2007 Excalibur Award for creative use of technology from Technology Association of Georgia.
